integrity: The proof uses the published vertex-prefix characterization, a coordinatewise Euclidean inequality, an exact doubled-spectrum extremum, and strict equality analysis. Exhaustive small-parameter enumeration is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard coordinate realization of partial permutohedra and ambient Euclidean diameter. It does not determine one-skeleton diameter, enclosing spheres, widths, extremal ellipsoids, or arbitrary generalized-permutohedron diameters.
title: The Euclidean diameter of partial permutohedra saturates exactly at \(m=2n\)
